name: Text Cursor
description: Pointer-following text trail inside a container. A word is stamped along the mouse path, or letters flow as a ribbon or a chain of repeated words, with fade, shrink, pop-in and float.
contents: Interactive root container that tracks the pointer
Absolutely positioned layer holding the trail text elements
behavior: Trail follows pointer movement over the container, also on pointer down, and fades out when the pointer leaves or stops
Stamp mode drops copies of the text at fixed distances along the path, oldest ones shrink, fade and exit
Ribbon mode spreads the letters of the text along the path like a snake with shrinking tail
Chain mode shows maxPoints copies of the text following the path in a line
Optional rotation along movement direction, random sway or wave, and back-out pop-in
Animation loop only runs while the trail is active; reduced motion disables float and pop-in
editableByProps: Trail text, color, font size, weight and family
Trail style via mode, spacing between items and number of items
Direction following, upright text, float, pop-in, shrink, fade, smoothing and exit timing
Hiding the native cursor, container size and extra styles via className and style

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the pop-in or exit easing
needsCodeEdit.where: backOut and smootherstep functions at the top of the file

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the float sway strength or speed
needsCodeEdit.where: float block inside the frame function

needsCodeEdit.change: Use different per-item content than a single repeated text
needsCodeEdit.where: take calls for links and stamps inside the useEffect

fixed: Root is h-full w-full relative, so the parent must have a defined height or the trail area collapses
Trail only reacts to the pointer inside the root container, not the whole page
Trail layer is aria-hidden and pointer-events-none, text is decorative
Needs a pointing device; on touch it only shows while dragging or tapping
Changing text, mode, or (in ribbon and chain modes) layout props rebuilds the trail elements
Ribbon mode splits the text into letters, so the text length sets the ribbon length
Trail items are clipped to the container (overflow hidden)

options.look: Copies of the word are dropped along the pointer path at fixed intervals, older ones shrinking, fading and floating away
options.useWhen: A playful hero where the word should be scattered behind the mouse like a trail of stickers

options.look: The letters of the text line up along the path like a snake, tapering toward the tail
options.useWhen: A tagline or brand word that should follow the cursor as one continuous flowing line

options.look: A fixed number of whole-word copies trail the pointer in a line along the path
options.useWhen: A short label or emoji-like word that should trail the cursor as a compact string of repeats
